scoring_justification: Effective masses recomputed from raw band structure data via parabolic fitting; compared to paper‑reported gold within an absolute tolerance of ±0.10 m_e.

hidden_assets.purpose: Effective mass reference values for Γ-M and Γ-X directions
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'calculated effective mass along Γ-M direction is 0.64m_e while along Γ-X direction is 0.68m_e'
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported values.

outputs.description: Band energies along Γ-M and Γ-X for the Ti d_{xy} conduction band(s). The checker fits a parabola around Γ to recompute effective masses and compares them to the paper-reported reference within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The agent must perform a full DFT+U relaxation and band structure calculation. The scored file must contain the band energies; the effective masses are not to be reported directly. The checker will recompute them from this raw data.
